payload.text: Year-end trailing P/E ran ~25.5-25.6x in 2023-25 vs ~18.9x on TTM GAAP EPS $12.31 at an uncertified price ($232.24); H1 2026 EPS +6% (+3% cc). Price component is uncertified.

Official Investor Day Select Slides (22) give no annual partnering schedule, no rent-relief/capital split, no remodel counts, no 2027-28 operating-income or EPS framework and no numeric bridge from the margin target.
Slides: payback ~4 years for franchisees after partnering and ~5-6 years for McDonald's on restaurant-level investment; forward-looking company estimates.
U.S. softness is an execution miss, not a strategy flaw; September U.S. comps positive (third-party transcript of the 2026-09-23 Investor Day, not checked against audio).
The 10-year Treasury at 5.27% (primary) sets a high hurdle; industry traffic is flat (per management); the stock fell ~4.8% on the 2026-09-23 Investor Day to new 52-week lows (Yahoo, uncertified).
The price needs only ~1.5-3.5% EPS growth to beat the 10-year, so much of the pessimism is already in the price.
Market-could-be-right: if EPS growth stays near the ~2.5% 2023-TTM CAGR, at 16-19x the stock earns ~2-6%, at or below the 10-year (5.27%) and below SPY's likely return.
Candidates only, NOT demonstrated: V1 parent EPS compounds >=5% through 2030 despite flat U.S. traffic; V2 the de-rating from ~25x to ~19x over-extrapolates a U.S. execution lapse.
Scenario-weighted IRR ~8.0% (severe/downside/base/strong -2.7/+2.0/+8.9/+15.4% at 10/20/45/25) vs 10-yr 5.27% and 3-mo 4.21%; advantage vs SPY not demonstrated. Illustrative, not a forecast.

payload.text: CPG organic growth by quarter: Q1 FY26 +5.4%, Q2 +0.8%, Q3 +6.9%, Q4 +5.7%, then Q1 FY27 -1.7%; CPG adj. EBITDA -9.7% to $166.2M.
Q1 FY27: PCG organic +7.9%, Consumer organic +5.2%; consolidated organic +3.1%, record adj. EBITDA $405.5M (+4.5%), adj. EPS $1.98 (+5.3%).

School/hospital slowdowns temporary; polyol shortage resolved; backlog rebuilding; CPG back to positive organic growth by fiscal year-end (auto-generated call transcripts, unverified against primary).
Census put-in-place spending through Aug 2026 (nominal, FRED mirror): health care -3.0% YoY, educational -0.5%, commercial -5.4% (-21% below its Sep-2023 peak).
The ~7-point CPG reversal is far larger than the 0-3% YoY decline in healthcare/education spending, which points to company-specific causes in addition to end-market softness.

Tremco/WTI backlog shrinkage predates and is separate from the polyol shortage; institutional demand looks cyclical-leaning and is unquantified. Temporary-vs-cyclical is mixed and not resolvable on current evidence.

Candidates only, NOT demonstrated: V1 roughly half or more of the CPG shortfall is transitory; V2 the de-rating to ~17x over-discounts a bounded cyclical risk. No quantified backlog, order data or primary leading-indicator reads.

If V1/V2 hold, base IRR ~10% vs 5.22% 10-yr / 4.23% bill; if the downside holds, ~-3%. Price $97.64 (2026-10-12) uncertified; advantage vs SPY not demonstrated. After Addendum 001: RPM has materially de-rated, but the evidence does not establish that the valuation fully compensates for a cyclical downturn.
